trailhead.label: The car park by Forte Strino, beside the SS42, the board’s start

cautions: The car park is beside the busy SS42: keep your dog on a short lead there.
A long day: 14.8 km and 837 m up, graded difficult by the board for its length.
Forest roads open to farm and forestry vehicles: keep your dog close if one comes.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The car park is beside the busy SS42: ke: Il parcheggio è accanto alla trafficata SS42: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.A long day: 14.8 km and 837 m up, graded: Una giornata lunga: 14,8 km e 837 m di salita, classificata difficile dal sito ufficiale per la lunghezza.
textIt.Forest roads open to farm and forestry v: Strade forestali aperte ai mezzi agricoli e forestali: tieni il cane vicino se ne arriva uno.
